key: TAKA: I was really hoping you wouldn't show up.
en: TAKA: I was really hoping you wouldn't show up.
ja: タカ: 本当は　来てほしくなかったんです。

key: TAKA: \PN, I...
en: TAKA: \PN, I...
ja: タカ: \PN　僕は……

key: TAKA: I'm sorry.
en: TAKA: I'm sorry.
ja: タカ: すみません。

key: I-- have to stop you here.
en: I-- have to stop you here.
ja: 僕は――　ここで　あなたを　止めなきゃ　いけません。

key: If I don't...
en: If I don't...
ja: そうしないと……

key: They're gonna say something like, there's no reason for me to stay, right?
en: They're gonna say something like, there's no reason for me to stay, right?
ja: 僕が　ここに　いる意味なんて　ないって　言われちゃいますよね?

key: Ace has been missing since the Water Treatment Center.
en: Ace has been missing since the Water Treatment Center.
ja: エースは　水処理センター以来　行方不明です。

key: The others are probably already--
en: The others are probably already--
ja: 他のみんなも　きっと　もう――

key: Or she's probably already...
en: Or she's probably already...
ja: それとも　彼女は　もう……

key: ...watching us from somewhere.
en: ...watching us from somewhere.
ja: ……どこかから　僕らを　見てるのかも。

key: TAKA: I don't-- have a choice anymore.
en: TAKA: I don't-- have a choice anymore.
ja: タカ: 僕には――　もう　選択肢が　ないんです。

key: As if I ever did.
en: As if I ever did.
ja: そもそも　あったこと　なんて　なかったのかも。

key: Not against you...
en: Not against you...
ja: あなたが相手では……

key: TAKA: ...and not against them.
en: TAKA: ...and not against them.
ja: タカ: ……彼らに　逆らうんじゃなくて。

key: So I guess that's it.
en: So I guess that's it.
ja: だから　これで　終わりです。

key: TAKA: This'll probably be the last time you have to deal with me.
en: TAKA: This'll probably be the last time you have to deal with me.
ja: タカ: たぶん　これが　最後に　僕の相手を　することに　なると思います。

key: TAKA: Sorry.
en: TAKA: Sorry.
ja: タカ: すみません。

key: TAKA: ...but you can.
en: TAKA: ...but you can.
ja: タカ: ……でも　あなたには　できます。

key: You've always been standing up to us.
en: You've always been standing up to us.
ja: あなたは　ずっと　僕らに　立ち向かってきました。

key: And you've always been winning.
en: And you've always been winning.
ja: そして　いつも　勝ってきました。

key: You're gonna keep doing that, aren't you?
en: You're gonna keep doing that, aren't you?
ja: これからも　そう　し続けるんですよね?

key: TAKA: Yeah. You always do, huh.
en: TAKA: Yeah. You always do, huh.
ja: タカ: ええ。あなたは　いつも　そうですね。

key: Did you ever even think to do anything else?
en: Did you ever even think to do anything else?
ja: 他のことを　考えたことなんて　あったんですか?

key: Cuz I don't think I have.
en: Cuz I don't think I have.
ja: 僕には　なかったと　思います。

key: I never thought anything could change, but here you are.
en: I never thought anything could change, but here you are.
ja: 何も　変わらないと　思ってたのに　あなたは　ここに　いる。

key: You rocked the boat and I've fallen right out of it.
en: You rocked the boat and I've fallen right out of it.
ja: あなたが　船を　揺らして　僕は　そこから　落っこちちゃったんです。

key: Splash.
en: Splash.
ja: ザブン。

key: TAKA: Hey, is that humility or just a joke?
en: TAKA: Hey, is that humility or just a joke?
ja: タカ: それって　謙遜ですか?　それとも　ただの　冗談?

key: You're startin' to sound like me.
en: You're startin' to sound like me.
ja: だんだん　僕みたいな　言い方に　なってきてますよ。

key: Maybe we're not so different.
en: Maybe we're not so different.
ja: 僕らって　案外　そんなに　違わないのかも。

key: Maybe...
en: Maybe...
ja: もしかしたら……

key: Maybe I can be more like you.
en: Maybe I can be more like you.
ja: もしかしたら　僕も　あなたみたいに　なれるかも。

key: But where does that leave me?
en: But where does that leave me?
ja: でも　それで　僕は　どうなるんでしょう?

key: When I go back a failure again, I won't get another chance.
en: When I go back a failure again, I won't get another chance.
ja: また　失敗して　戻ったら　次の　チャンスは　ないでしょうね。

key: And you...
en: And you...
ja: それに　あなたは……

key: ...will keep fighting.
en: ...will keep fighting.
ja: ……これからも　戦い続けるんでしょうね。

key: TAKA: Can I come with you?
en: TAKA: Can I come with you?
ja: タカ: 一緒に　行っても　いいですか?

key: TAKA: Really?
en: TAKA: Really?
ja: タカ: 本当に?

key: TAKA: All right, here's the plan:
en: TAKA: All right, here's the plan:
ja: タカ: わかりました　計画は　こうです:

key: I don't have a single clue.
en: I don't have a single clue.
ja: 僕には　まったく　見当も　つきません。

key: So I'm just gonna follow you for now, okay?
en: So I'm just gonna follow you for now, okay?
ja: だから　とりあえず　あなたに　ついていきます　いいですか?

key: I'll try not to get in your way.
en: I'll try not to get in your way.
ja: 邪魔に　ならないように　気をつけます。

key: And uh, I kinda took a bunch of healing items from base before they sent me here...
en: And uh, I kinda took a bunch of healing items from base before they sent me here...
ja: それと　その　ここに　送られる前に　基地から　回復アイテムを　いくつか　くすねてきたんです……

key: So I'll heal your Pokémon whenever you need, okay?
en: So I'll heal your Pokémon whenever you need, okay?
ja: だから　必要なときは　いつでも　ポケモンを　回復させますね　いいですか?

key: If I can find somewhere safe to hide, I think I'll lay low there for a while.
en: If I can find somewhere safe to hide, I think I'll lay low there for a while.
ja: どこか　安全な隠れ場所が　見つかったら　しばらく　そこで　息を　潜めてようと思います。

key: Maybe long enough that I'll get off of that woman's radar.
en: Maybe long enough that I'll get off of that woman's radar.
ja: あの女の人の　目に　留まらなくなるくらいの間は。

key: After that... let's beat Team Meteor together.
en: After that... let's beat Team Meteor together.
ja: その後は……　一緒に　メテオ団を　倒しましょう。

key: I'll follow your lead, \PN.
en: I'll follow your lead, \PN.
ja: \PNに　ついていきます。

key: TAKA: Yeah, I'd just be in the way, right?
en: TAKA: Yeah, I'd just be in the way, right?
ja: タカ: ですよね　僕は　ただの　邪魔に　なりますよね。

key: I get it.
en: I get it.
ja: わかってます。

key: I guess this is it then.
en: I guess this is it then.
ja: じゃあ　これで　お別れですね。

key: See ya, \PN.
en: See ya, \PN.
ja: またね\PN。

key: TAKA: Welcome home sweet home.
en: TAKA: Welcome home sweet home.
ja: タカ: ようこそ　我が家へ。

key: I've somehow managed to avoid melting into a blistering puddle of sands, which frankly might be the greatest victory I've ever had.
en: I've somehow managed to avoid melting into a blistering puddle of sands, which frankly might be the greatest victory I've ever had.
ja: どうにか　しゃく熱の砂だまりに　溶けずに　済みました　正直　これまでで　一番の　勝利かも　しれません。

key: Well, off to wherever, right?
en: Well, off to wherever, right?
ja: さて　どこへでも　行きましょうか。

key: CORIN-ROUGE: Ahaha...
en: CORIN-ROUGE: Ahaha...
ja: コリン・ルージュ: あはは……

key: So you've caught up to me even here, have you?
en: So you've caught up to me even here, have you?
ja: こんな場所まで　私に　追いついてきたのか。

key: My fair lady, I must apologize to you with every drop of sparkling sincerity which my weary heart can muster.
en: My fair lady, I must apologize to you with every drop of sparkling sincerity which my weary heart can muster.
ja: 我が麗しの淑女よ　この疲れた心が　振り絞れる限りの　誠意を　込めて　君に　謝らなければ　ならない。

key: I am not known to be so oblivious to the desires of beautiful women such as yourself,
en: I am not known to be so oblivious to the desires of beautiful women such as yourself,
ja: 私は　君のような　美しい女性の願いに　これほど　鈍いと　知られては　いないのだが

key: But for you to have followed me so far even now...
en: But for you to have followed me so far even now...
ja: それでも　今なお　これほど　遠くまで　私を　追いかけてくるとは……

key: Darling, you could have just asked and I would have swept you away myself.
en: Darling, you could have just asked and I would have swept you away myself.
ja: ダーリン　頼んでくれさえすれば　私自身が　君を　さらっていったのに。

key: Ah, but there's the game, is it not?
en: Ah, but there's the game, is it not?
ja: ああ　だが　それが　この駆け引きと　いうものだろう?

key: A dance moves not in one direction, so neither must hearts.
en: A dance moves not in one direction, so neither must hearts.
ja: ダンスは　一方向にだけ　動くものではない　心もまた　そうであるべきだ。

key: Nor must I, who finds his breath stolen away not by the golden arid flourish amongst which we find ourselves,
en: Nor must I, who finds his breath stolen away not by the golden arid flourish amongst which we find ourselves,
ja: 私もまた　この黄金の乾いた景色に　息を　奪われているわけではなく

key: But by the fever of your passion compared to which such a scalding scene as this is but a candle to a star.
en: But by the fever of your passion compared to which such a scalding scene as this is but a candle to a star.
ja: 君の情熱の熱に　息を　奪われているのだ　この焼けつくような光景など　星に対するろうそくの炎に　過ぎない。

key: Very well, my sweet supernova--
en: Very well, my sweet supernova--
ja: よろしい　我が甘き超新星よ――

key: I shall deny you no longer.
en: I shall deny you no longer.
ja: もう　君を　拒みはしない。

key: It is all of me you may have to keep, and the same I would say for my treasures too...
en: It is all of me you may have to keep, and the same I would say for my treasures too...
ja: この私の　すべてを　君に　あげよう　私の宝についても　同じことが　言えるが……

key: Alas, that is impossible,
en: Alas, that is impossible,
ja: ああ　だが　それは　不可能なんだ

key: Since my greatest treasure-- is you.
en: Since my greatest treasure-- is you.
ja: 私の一番の宝物は――　君　自身　なのだから。

key: Nevertheless!
en: Nevertheless!
ja: とはいえ!

key: Such a place as this will not do for our most climactic encounter!
en: Such a place as this will not do for our most climactic encounter!
ja: こんな場所では　私たちの最も劇的な出会いには　ふさわしくない!

key: I offer you points for persistence,
en: I offer you points for persistence,
ja: 君の粘り強さには　得点を　あげよう

key: But I'm afraid that's all you'll get from me.
en: But I'm afraid that's all you'll get from me.
ja: だが　残念ながら　私から　得られるのは　それだけだ。

key: I cannot return what I have stolen--
en: I cannot return what I have stolen--
ja: 私が　盗んだものを　返すことは　できない――

key: It is too critical.
en: It is too critical.
ja: あまりにも　重要すぎるのでね。

key: If you would like to see why,
en: If you would like to see why,
ja: その理由が　知りたいなら

key: Meet me in the place where the only thing more broken than the trains is our lives.
en: Meet me in the place where the only thing more broken than the trains is our lives.
ja: 列車よりも　なお　壊れているものと言えば　私たちの人生くらいしか　ない場所で　会おう。

key: No tricks this time.
en: No tricks this time.
ja: 今度は　トリックなしだ。

key: No running.
en: No running.
ja: 逃げも　しない。

key: There is something I'd like to show you.
en: There is something I'd like to show you.
ja: 君に　見せたいものが　あるんだ。

key: I shall wait for you the only way I know how:
en: I shall wait for you the only way I know how:
ja: 私に　できる唯一の方法で　君を　待つとしよう:

key: Breath, bated-- and heart, patient.
en: Breath, bated-- and heart, patient.
ja: 息を　潜めて――　心は　辛抱強く。

key: Until then.
en: Until then.
ja: それでは　また。

key: TAKA: Uh.
en: TAKA: Uh.
ja: タカ: えっと。

key: What?
en: What?
ja: 何です?

key: TAKA: I feel like I just got into a new TV series but accidentally started with the last episode.
en: TAKA: I feel like I just got into a new TV series but accidentally started with the last episode.
ja: タカ: 新しいテレビドラマを　見始めたと思ったら　うっかり　最終回から　見ちゃった気分です。

key: So you uh, know that guy?
en: So you uh, know that guy?
ja: つまり　その　あの人のこと　知ってるんですか?

key: A list of arrival times is printed on the sign.
en: A list of arrival times is printed on the sign.
ja: 看板には　到着時刻の一覧が　印刷されている。

key: Wait for a ride back to the city?
en: Wait for a ride back to the city?
ja: 街へ　戻る乗り物を　待ちますか?

key: TAKA: Uhh hey, I don't think it's really a good idea for me to head into the city right now.
en: TAKA: Uhh hey, I don't think it's really a good idea for me to head into the city right now.
ja: タカ: あの　今　街に　向かうのは　あんまり　いい考えじゃ　ないと思います。

key: If the other Meteors are after me, I'd rather take my chances out here.
en: If the other Meteors are after me, I'd rather take my chances out here.
ja: 他のメテオ団の連中に　狙われてるなら　むしろ　ここで　運を　試したほうが　ましです。

key: You really gonna go?
en: You really gonna go?
ja: 本当に　行くんですか?

key: TAKA: All right. Do what you need to.
en: TAKA: All right. Do what you need to.
ja: タカ: わかりました。やるべきことを　やってきてください。

key: I'll be here, practicing my best sand dune impression.
en: I'll be here, practicing my best sand dune impression.
ja: 僕は　ここで　精一杯　砂丘の物真似でも　してますね。

key: TAKA: So what, did someone just drop all these here by accident or what?
en: TAKA: So what, did someone just drop all these here by accident or what?
ja: タカ: これって　誰かが　うっかり　全部　ここに　落としてったとか　そんな感じですか?

key: TAKA: Eh? There was one buried under the sand there too?
en: TAKA: Eh? There was one buried under the sand there too?
ja: タカ: え?　あそこの砂の下にも　一つ　埋まってたんですか?

key: TAKA: Think someone dropped this from up in the Beryl Ward?
en: TAKA: Think someone dropped this from up in the Beryl Ward?
ja: タカ: これって　ベリル区の上から　誰かが　落としたんでしょうか?

key: I'd try it on, but I already got my scarf.
en: I'd try it on, but I already got my scarf.
ja: 着けてみたい　ところですけど　もう　自分のスカーフが　あるので。

key: By the way, do yourself a favor and never wear a scarf to a desert.
en: By the way, do yourself a favor and never wear a scarf to a desert.
ja: ちなみに　自分のために　言っときますけど　砂漠では　絶対　スカーフを　着けない方が　いいですよ。

key: TAKA: So, do you just pick up any old junk you find?
en: TAKA: So, do you just pick up any old junk you find?
ja: タカ: つまり　見つけた　がらくたは　何でも　拾っちゃうんですか?

key: I guess that's why I'm here too, haha.
en: I guess that's why I'm here too, haha.
ja: まあ　僕も　その一つとして　ここに　いるんでしょうけど　ははは。

key: TAKA: Why can Pokémon learn moves from discs like this anyway?
en: TAKA: Why can Pokémon learn moves from discs like this anyway?
ja: タカ: そもそも　なんで　ポケモンって　こういうディスクから　わざを　覚えられるんでしょうね?

key: And more importantly, can I do the same?
en: And more importantly, can I do the same?
ja: それより　大事なのは　僕にも　できるのかってことですけど。

key: Uh, not this move though. Too much energy.
en: Uh, not this move though. Too much energy.
ja: あ、でも　このわざは　やめときます。エネルギー　使いすぎです。

key: TAKA: I feel bad for these Pokémon.
en: TAKA: I feel bad for these Pokémon.
ja: タカ: このポケモンたちが　かわいそうです。

key: I guess the sands will give them a proper burial in time.
en: I guess the sands will give them a proper burial in time.
ja: きっと　そのうち　砂が　ちゃんと　埋めてくれるんでしょうね。

key: That's probably all I can ask for too.
en: That's probably all I can ask for too.
ja: たぶん　僕にも　それくらいしか　望めないんでしょう。

key: TAKA: So, was this part of the rock or was it just left here by coincidence?
en: TAKA: So, was this part of the rock or was it just left here by coincidence?
ja: タカ: これって　岩の一部だったんですか?　それとも　たまたま　ここに　あっただけですか?

key: TAKA: Wait, what?
en: TAKA: Wait, what?
ja: タカ: え、ちょっと待って　何ですか?

key: Uh, so was that just a mirage?
en: Uh, so was that just a mirage?
ja: えっと　あれって　ただの　しんきろうだったんですか?

key: There's no way we could've walked up that close and touched it if it were just that, right?
en: There's no way we could've walked up that close and touched it if it were just that, right?
ja: そうだとしたら　あんなに　近づいて　触れるはず　ないですよね?

key: I'm... confused.
en: I'm... confused.
ja: 僕……　混乱してます。

key: TAKA: I'm not going to get used to that.
en: TAKA: I'm not going to get used to that.
ja: タカ: これには　慣れられそうに　ないです。

key: TAKA: Frankly, that's a metaphor for my life.
en: TAKA: Frankly, that's a metaphor for my life.
ja: タカ: 正直　それって　僕の人生そのものの比喩ですね。

key: I need to take some time to destressitize. Wanna play?
en: I need to take some time to destressitize. Wanna play?
ja: ちょっと　ストレス発散する時間が　必要でね。遊んでいくかい?

key: Well played.
en: Well played.
ja: アルティミス: よくやったね。

key: I take Jinx, my Absol, with me everywhere. She helps me avoid disaster.
en: I take Jinx, my Absol, with me everywhere. She helps me avoid disaster.
ja: うちのアブソルの　ジンクスは　どこへでも　連れて行くんだ。災難を　避けるのに　役立ってくれるからね。

key: The text on the pillar is too faded to read.
en: The text on the pillar is too faded to read.
ja: 柱に　書かれた文字は　薄れすぎて　読めない。

key: TAKA: Mood.
en: TAKA: Mood.
ja: タカ: わかります。

key: Ah... Trainer, you wouldn't happen to have any Fresh Water to spare, would you?
en: Ah... Trainer, you wouldn't happen to have any Fresh Water to spare, would you?
ja: ああ……　トレーナーさん　ミネラルウォーターの　余分　持ってたり　しない?

key: If so, can I have it?!
en: If so, can I have it?!
ja: もし　あるなら　もらえないかな?!

key: \PN handed over the Fresh Water.
en: \PN handed over the Fresh Water.
ja: \PNは　ミネラルウォーターを　渡した。

key: ... *gulp gulp gulp*
en: ... *gulp gulp gulp*
ja: ……ゴクゴクゴク

key: Ah, that hit the spot!
en: Ah, that hit the spot!
ja: ああ　染み渡るぜ!

key: Thanks, Trainer!
en: Thanks, Trainer!
ja: ありがとう　トレーナーさん!

key: It's not as if I didn't come out here prepared, you know!
en: It's not as if I didn't come out here prepared, you know!
ja: 何も　準備なしで　ここに　来たわけじゃ　ないんだけどね!

key: I brought my trusty Politoed and thought its Drizzle Ability would be enough to produce however much water I needed!
en: I brought my trusty Politoed and thought its Drizzle Ability would be enough to produce however much water I needed!
ja: 頼りにしてる　ニョロトノを　連れてきて　あめふらしの特性が　あれば　必要な水は　いくらでも　作れると　思ってたんだ!

key: But lo and behold, its rain seemed to end after just five turns...
en: But lo and behold, its rain seemed to end after just five turns...
ja: でも　なんと　その雨　たった5ターンで　止んじまってな……

key: It didn't used to be that way, you know?
en: It didn't used to be that way, you know?
ja: 昔は　そうじゃ　なかったんだけどな?

key: Not to sound old, but back in my generation, we had the grandest weather wars known to mankind!
en: Not to sound old, but back in my generation, we had the grandest weather wars known to mankind!
ja: 年寄りくさく　聞こえるかもしれないが　おれたちの世代じゃ　人類史上　最も壮大な天候戦争ってのが　あったんだぞ!

key: Weather abilities were permanent back then, you know? Just set it and forget it.
en: Weather abilities were permanent back then, you know? Just set it and forget it.
ja: あの頃は　天候特性は　ずっと　持続してたんだ。セットしたら　あとは　ほったらかしで　良かった。

key: Say, if you ever want to relive the glory days of weather, try telling someone "gen5weather" when they ask you for a password!
en: Say, if you ever want to relive the glory days of weather, try telling someone "gen5weather" when they ask you for a password!
ja: そうだ　あの天候の栄光時代を　もう一度　味わいたく　なったら　パスワードを　聞かれたときに「gen5weather」って　言ってみるといい!

key: Learn from my mistakes!
en: Learn from my mistakes!
ja: おれの失敗から　学んでくれよ!

key: Ah... Everyone for themselves, is that it...?
en: Ah... Everyone for themselves, is that it...?
ja: ああ……　みんな　自分のことしか　考えてないってわけか……?

key: I'm so parched-- I seriously need some right now!
en: I'm so parched-- I seriously need some right now!
ja: 喉が　カラカラでな――　今すぐ　本気で　必要なんだ!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
